details: Every coordinate needed to distinguish two concepts belongs to their effective range.
proof: A coordinate outside the effective range has the same value in every concept, so deleting it cannot merge two restrictions.  A minimum distinguishing coordinate set may therefore be chosen inside the effective range, giving $\mathrm{R}(\mathcal{H})\le\mathrm{E}(\mathcal{H})$.
name: Effective Range / Distinguishing Range
